description: Search SimplyGlobal visitor insurance plans and prices for one traveler. Returns each plan family with its price, coverage maximum, deductible, the compare_page_url the traveler can open, and the exact option to choose on that page. Plans that do not offer a requested coverage maximum or deductible are listed in not_offered with their available options; when the compare page's default card for a plan's coverage range is a different option, the plan is flagged with page_default_differs.

coverage_maximum_usd.description: Optional exact coverage maximum in USD (for example 100000 for $100,000). Only plans offering exactly that maximum are returned.

deductible_usd.description: Optional exact deductible in USD (for example 250 for $250).

plan_type.description: The plan-type label shown on the SimplyGlobal compare page.

coverage_area.description: Worldwide coverage that includes the US and Canada (default), or US-only coverage.

end_date.description: Last day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; at least one day after start_date.

start_date.description: First day of coverage as YYYY-MM-DD; today (UTC) or later.

traveler_age.description: The traveler's age in whole years on the coverage start date; carriers price by that age.

name: search_visitor_insurance_plans
title: Search visitor insurance plans and prices
